subject: proper way to build cmdstan 2.5 with neg_binomial2 from stan's development branch?

messages.author: 3f37be0cf708d442
messages.subject: proper way to build cmdstan 2.5 with neg_binomial2 from stan's development branch?
parts:
Hello,

I (apparently naively) tried to build a cmdstan version with the updated neg_binomial_2 version through following simple steps.
- download and untar the current distribution (2.5) of cmdstan
- replace original file  stan/src/stan/prob/distributions/univariate/neg_binomial_2.hpp  with the development version taken from here: https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/blob/develop/src/stan/prob/distributions/univariate/discrete/neg_binomial.hpp
- build cmdstan as usual

However, when I try to make a model that I can make with unmodified cmdstan, I reveive following error message:

"
stan/src/stan/prob/distributions/univariate/discrete/neg_binomial_2.hpp(8): catastrophic error: cannot open source file "stan/error_handling/scalar/check_consistent_sizes.hpp"
  #include <stan/error_handling/scalar/check_consistent_sizes.hpp>
                                                                  ^

compilation aborted for src/cmdstan/main.cpp (code 4)
make: *** [/usit/abel/u1/guidopb/programming/R/REP/RepStanNov2014/stanmodels/HNB2Reg/HNB2Regression] Error 4
"

Is there a way to compile a modified version of cmdstan without producing the error?
There should be some way to either modify the expected size of neg_binomial2 or to trun of the check.

Best - Guido

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] proper way to build cmdstan 2.5 with neg_binomial2 from stan's development branch?
parts:
stan-dev/stan is a submodule of stan-dev/cmdstan. So you
need to get a version of Stan and include it in the indicated
subdirectory of cmdstan.

The fix to neg_binomial_2 is in stan, not cmdstan, so that's what
you'll need an updated version of.

- Bob

messages.author: 3f37be0cf708d442
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] proper way to build cmdstan 2.5 with neg_binomial2 from stan's development branch?
parts:
To make sure that I understood correctly, here is what I did:
- download & unzip the cmdstan development version to cmdstan-development
- download & unzip the stan development version and move it into the cmdstan-development/stan
- build with "make build" in cmdstan/development

Following these steps, I could build cmdstan and compile models it with both g++ and icc.

Thanks again for your help!
Guido

a new stan into an old cmdstan or vice-versa.
